# Copilot UI Instructions For This Repository

When generating or modifying any UI in this repository, follow the design system in:
- docs/05_UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md

Mandatory rules:
- Default to minimalist blue and white style.
- Use the exact palette and spacing tokens from the design system.
- Use strong typography hierarchy and avoid clutter.
- Use subtle animation only (no flashy or bouncy effects).
- Keep surfaces clean, premium, and trustworthy.
- Apply the same style consistently across all existing and new UI artifacts.

If a user asks for UI work and does not specify a different design system, always apply docs/05_UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.
